text:
maria: FYI planning a short maintenance window for APAC on-prem rack (site A) next Tue 00:30-02:00 SGT. vendor needs a planned PSU power transition. expecting rolling soft reboots per rack, ~45m per rack with staged backfill.

ops-bot: Scheduled: apac-site-a-rack-maint at 2026-03-25T00:30:00+08:00 -> 2026-03-25T02:00:00+08:00. Notifying oncall.

sanjay: Thanks. Can we confirm worst-case GPU count impacted?

maria: Worst-case if both PDUs flake we pull 2 racks -> ~32 GPUs out, but normal plan is 1 rack at a time -> ~16 GPUs. We'll do cohort backfill from eu-central burst pool.

kyle: For Dedicated tenants, do we have SLA fallback? customers with reserved capacity should be routed to their reserved pools — need to ensure routing policy pins are honored during the reboots. I can toggle a stricter policy for the window.

jess: Please surface list of customers in site A with reserved pools and CS will pre-notify them. also want confirmation on whether cost cover needed for emergency backfill.

maria: Uploading short runbook for the window. Key points: cordon -> drain with live-warmup -> remove rack -> vendor power swap -> rejoin -> prefix-cache warmup. Expect KV cache cold-miss spike.

oncall: Who's the pager for 00:30-03:00 SGT?

sanjay: I'll take primary pager, @kyle on secondary. oncall has the runbook link.

maria: Runbook excerpt:
```
# preflight checklist
- verify burst capacity pool eu-central available (capable: 40 GPUs)
- pre-warm prefix cache on burst pool (run: scripts/prewarm_kv.sh)
- set routing weight: site-a -> 0.2, eu-central -> 0.8 during rack drain
- adjust autoscaler cooldowns to -10% muted scaling
```

sanjay: Add note: disable aggressive batching autoscaler during warmup, otherwise queueing spikes will torque latency.

kyle: For routing weight change, I'll push a short-lived policy with rollback in 10m. snippet:
`curl -X POST https://infra-api/realloc -d '{"policy":"apac-maint-2026-03-25","weights":{"site-a":0.2,"eu-central":0.8}}'`

jess: CS: We'll notify these accounts: AcmeCorp, Finlytics, HealthNova. They asked for at least 48h notice — sending email now.

maria: Cost note: backfill from eu-central will be billed as on-demand; estimate ~2-3k USD for a 90m window if both racks are drained. Ops budget OK?

kyle: Finance confirmed we can cover emergency backfill under infra contingency, but ask CS to flag for billing if usage >5k.

sanjay: Prewarm command to run on burst instances:
```
./scripts/prewarm_kv.sh --model gptx-13b --tokens 5000 --parallel 8
```

oncall: We'll have an oncall loop every 10m while a rack is down. Please post progress messages to this thread when you hit these milestones: cordoned, drained, power-swap, rejoin, warm-cache-ok.

maria: Understood. I'll post updates. First milestone scheduled 00:35 SGT cordon of rack-3.

ops-bot: Reminder: rolling reboot window conflicts with backup job at 01:15 SGT. Please confirm backup can be shifted to 02:30.

sanjay: Good catch. I'll coordinate with backup team to move to 02:30.

jess: Customer ask: Can we route critical API traffic to dedicated regional fallback so timeouts don't surface?

kyle: Yes. I'll create temporary route override for `api-critical` to go to eu-central reserved pool. Will keep TTL 2h and auto-revoke post-window.

maria: Cache warmup expectation: 15-20m after rejoin to hit steady p95. plan to increase token cache retention from 2->5 checkpoints for warmup.

sanjay: If we see >15% p99 latency regression after warmup, auto-fallback to smaller quantized model variants should happen. I'll enable model-fallback: `gptx-13b -> gptx-8q` if latency>1200ms for 5m.

jess: I'll include fallback info in customer note. Hopefully not needed. :crossed_fingers: 

oncall: Just to confirm runbook contact numbers: vendor on-call (Ravi), ops lead (maria), oncall primary (sanjay), secondary (kyle).

maria: All set. I'll start the prewarm at 23:45 SGT to reduce burst time. Will post a final check-in 30m before window.

ops-bot: Notification sent to #customers-ops and #dedicated-tenants channels.

sanjay: one more: telemetry – enable higher resolution traces for model routing during window (5s sample) so we can triage fallback causes quickly.

kyle: done. policy pushed. rollback scheduled 03:15 SGT.

maria: Thanks everyone. Posting first prewarm success update in 10m.

jess: thx — CS will stand by for any customer escalations.

oncall: acknowledged.
